## Objective
- Improve the existing RTS game: enlarge the map, require exploration with unexplored areas blacked out, add more detailed unit/building models, and fix tank movement during combat.

## Requirements
- Deliver a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots by saving small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px wide) and reading only the latest; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.
- Briefly note assumptions when finishing.

## Decisions
- Expanded the renderer’s world from 100 to 160 units and changed the initial camera zoom/position to show exploration from the starting base.
- Added a fog-of-war overlay concept using a 128×128 discovery grid and unit/building vision radii.

## Work State
### Completed
- `game.js`: changed initial camera to zoom 1.5 and center on the player HQ.
- `game.js`: removed the combat-loop `continue` that prevented units with targets from processing movement.
- `renderer3d.js`: increased world dimensions and updated terrain, camera, entity positions, and shot coordinates accordingly.
- `renderer3d.js`: added fog texture/plane and an `updateFog(frame)` function that tracks explored/visible cells.

### Active
- Finish and verify fog-of-war: call `updateFog(frame)` during rendering and add `resetFog()` to clear discovery state.
- Remodel buildings, tanks, and soldiers with more realistic detail.
- Run the game, inspect behavior, and capture/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- `game.js` calls `renderer.resetFog()` in `setup()`, but `renderer3d.js` does not yet expose that method; the game will error at setup until implemented.
- `updateFog(frame)` is not yet called from `render()`, so the overlay currently does not reveal/hide the map.

## Next Move
1. Complete fog integration and expose `resetFog()` from `createBattlefield`.
2. Build out detailed models for soldiers, tanks, and buildings in `renderer3d.js`.
3. Test startup, exploration, combat movement, and gameplay; fix any issues.
4. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot, then summarize assumptions and results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: game setup, camera start, movement/combat update logic, and fog reset call.
- `renderer3d.js`: 3D world, entity models, and incomplete fog-of-war implementation.

## Important Context
- No tests or browser verification have been run yet.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Improve the RTS game with a larger explorable map, fog of war, detailed units and buildings, and tanks that move during combat.
- Deliver a playable game and verify it in-browser.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest image; use a full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Expanded the rendered world from 100 to 160 units and adjusted the starting camera to show the player base.
- Added a 128×128 discovery/visibility grid; friendly units and buildings reveal terrain based on vision radius.
- Removed the combat-loop `continue` that prevented targeted units from processing movement.
- Refined collector, scout, and tank models with added vehicle and armor details.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded the world and adjusted the starting camera.
